summary: Three-slice shared-contract follow-on (foundation→properties): W1 elevates additive OpenAPI GET /reservations and UML OCL vocabulary for authorized full-dump list and UnauthorizedError; W2 depends_on W1 and delivers authorized list success (empty + nonempty LookupResponse-equivalent dump, shared visibility, no filters, no mutation); W3 depends_on W1 and delivers unauthorized list UnauthorizedError without mutation.
acceptance_of_whole:
Scenario: Soft-hold collection list covers authorized full dump and unauthorized failure
  Given the inventory reservation service for clients
  When clients exercise authorized soft-hold collection list (empty and nonempty) and unauthorized list
  Then authorized list returns all currently visible soft-holds in the same visibility universe as get-by-id with no filter dimensions and without mutating stock or holds
  And authorized success is one full dump of LookupResponse-equivalent items including availableStock; empty when none are visible
  And unauthorized list fails with UnauthorizedError without mutating stock or holds (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ)
  And openapi/openapi.yaml documents additive GET /reservations while prior reserve/release/expire/lookup/concurrent operations remain
  And contracts/**/*.ocl and passing tests/contracts/** cover full-dump list success (including empty) and UnauthorizedError
  And payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, UI, notifications, TTL extend, list-by-SKU/filters/paging, and prior Feature rewrites are not required

human_gate.reason: ChangeBrief scope is explicit; Grill Q1–Q3 Means settled; open_questions are non-blocking deferrals to OpenAPI apply / knowledge harvest; foundation then two property slices map cleanly to R1–R5 and SC1–SC4 without blocking ambiguity.

items.intent: Deliver authorized collection list so any authorized opaque principal receives one full dump of all currently visible soft-holds (LookupResponse-equivalent including availableStock; empty OK; same visibility as get-by-id; no filters; no mutation), extending OCL-derived Vitest and implementation after W1.
items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Authorized list returns a full dump of visible soft-holds without mutation
  Given a reservation service with zero or more currently visible soft-holds
  And an authorized opaque principal
  When the principal lists soft-holds
  Then the service returns all currently visible soft-holds in the same visibility universe as get-by-id
  And the response is one full dump with no paging and no sku, status, or time filter dimensions
  And each item is LookupResponse-equivalent with holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt, and availableStock
  And the collection is empty when none are visible
  And stock and holds are unchanged
items.scenario_name: Authorized list returns a full dump of visible soft-holds without mutation

human_gate.reason: Authorized full-dump list success (empty and nonempty) follows settled Grill Means; exact success JSON envelope deferred to OpenAPI apply.
